_about: protag2: poses of the Anti-hero's entries, generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs from render/anim/tools/waves/protag2.mjs and docs/combat/pending/entries.antihero.protag2.json. Parked: baked only with --waves; an entry beat (or a rush beat naming one) plays an entry, and none does in live matches. Render only, outside the sim's data hash.

pe.coil_spring.start._orig: a bounce: the knees bent, the weight low and forward, both open hands out ahead of the chest, ready to spring

pe.coil_spring.travel._orig: sprung into a long flat line, the lead arm out ahead with the palm open and the other folded in, the legs together behind

pe.coil_spring.arrive._orig: landed in a lunge, the hands open and up in front of him

pe.plant_coil.travel._orig: a spring of the knees without a step: one hand up at the face, one low, the weight forward

pe.plant_coil.arrive._orig: sprung and set: the hands open, one high and one low, the head up

pe.skid.run._orig: a quick run, the arms pumping loosely and open

pe.skid.drop._orig: dropping into the slide on the heels, one hand reaching down for balance

pe.skid.slide._orig: sliding on the heels, the weight held a little higher than the blade of the rival

pe.skid.arrive._orig: the slide ending in a wide low stance, one hand down, one up

pe.drop_back.travel._orig: dropping back a step with the knees bent and the hands kept up and open, the eyes on him

pe.drop_back.arrive._orig: set again a step back, still springy, the hands up

pe.rooted.start._orig: he does not move his feet: a springy stand with the open hands up at the chest and the blow coming out of it

pe.hop_back.travel._orig: a light hop back with the knees up and the hands kept open and forward

pe.hop_back.arrive._orig: landed springy, the hands up and open, the eyes on him

pe.air_roll.start._orig: springing off into the roll: the body arched and the arms flung up and open, the legs trailing

pe.air_roll.over._orig: going over: the body one stretched line pitched past level, the arms reaching ahead of the head and the legs stretched out behind, never a ball

pe.air_roll.inverted._orig: upside down at the top of the roll, still one long line: the arms stretched toward the ground, the legs up

pe.air_roll.under._orig: coming round: the head back and the arms and legs still long, the line a quarter turn from where it began

pe.air_roll.open._orig: out of the roll into a long flat line, one arm cocked and the other open ahead: the blow comes next

pe.cartwheel_step.reach._orig: the weight thrown forward and both open hands reaching for the ground

pe.cartwheel_step.over._orig: over on the hands: the body upside down and straight, the legs high and apart, a circle through the air

pe.cartwheel_step.land._orig: landed in the stance on the far side of the circle, the hands up and open

pe.dash.start._orig: the take-off: low, the lead shoulder dropped and its forearm guard up, the other arm folded to the chest (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.dash.travel._orig: one narrow blade: the shoulder and its forearm guard lead, the other arm folded to the chest, the legs together behind (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.dash.arrive._orig: the arrival: the speed scrubbed off, the open hands already forward where the blow begins (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.arc_dive.start._orig: a kick upward off nothing, the back arched and the arms swept behind (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.arc_dive.climb._orig: the climb: the body one line pitched up, the arms trailing low (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.arc_dive.top._orig: the fold at the top: the body bending over, the striking arm swinging up and over (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.arc_dive.arrive._orig: coming down head first over the rival, the striking limb already raised, the body a dropped blade (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.rising.start._orig: the push off: the body upright, the open hands flat along the thighs (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.rising.travel._orig: straight up from below: the body one vertical line, the open hands flat along the thighs, the feet together (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.rising.arrive._orig: under the rival: the body a vertical line, the striking arm low and loaded, the other hand up (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.spiral.start._orig: a banked turn away from the rival, one arm leading the curve (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.spiral.travel._orig: banked like a blade on edge: the whole body leaning into the curve, the lead arm out along it (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.spiral.arrive._orig: arriving from the side: the body swung round to face the rival, the hands open and forward (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.step_in.start._orig: the stance, the hands open where the strike starts (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.step_in.travel._orig: one short flat step, the head level, the hands already forward (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.step_in.arrive._orig: the step landed, the weight forward, the hands ready (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.pivot.start._orig: the stance (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.pivot.travel._orig: the pivot: the weight on the lead foot, the rear hip swinging round, the shoulders a beat behind the hips (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.pivot.arrive._orig: out of the turn: the hips squared, the shoulders catching up, the hands ready (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.lane_step.start._orig: the stance (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.lane_step.travel._orig: a sidestep toward the camera: the body turned a quarter, the near foot reaching across and out (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.lane_step.arrive._orig: set on the new line, the shoulders square again and the hands ready (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.backstep_counter.start._orig: the stance (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.backstep_counter.travel._orig: one step back with the weight on the rear leg, the open hands up (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.backstep_counter.arrive._orig: the weight shifted forward again: ready to step straight back in as the rival follows (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.fade.start._orig: the stance (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.fade.travel._orig: the lean away: the head and chest slipping back out of range from the hips, the feet planted (the rival's pose in his profile)

pe.fade.arrive._orig: coming forward again with the counter (the rival's pose in his profile)
